Sunehri Dhara
                     Unyielding in Every Environment

 This piece is not designed—it is sculpted like a Rajasthani
                      desert tree.

This structure is an inspiration from the flower bearing fruit
of Khejdi tree. The leather back texture defines the shell; the
glass flower describes the resilience of the tree by blooming
in the scorching desert and the brass speaks of the richness
  and importance this tree hold in the Rajasthani culture.

Technical

Finish: Brass & Leather Finish
 Material: Metal + Glass + Leather
 Light Source: Integrated Warm LED
Weight (Kg): 22 Kg
 Size : 1500 mm × 550 mm × 1250 mm




*Size, shape, and design can be customized to project requirements.

Falpushpa
                            Motif of Jaipur

    This collection is our humble attempt to preserve
 tradition while reinterpreting it for contemporary living.
Inspired by the rich visual language found in architecture,
      textiles, and heritage motifs, each piece reflects a
 dialogue between culture, craftsmanship, and modern
                        design.

By combining finely crafted metalwork with hand-blown glass, the collection

Abhaas
                     The realisation

This installation reflects the enduring power of growth,
  even in its final stage. Inspired by the deep cultural
symbolism of charred bamboo in traditional heritage,
    the piece reinterprets its meaning through a
           contemporary artistic lens.

Technical

Finish: Charred Black + Antique Brass
Material: Burnt Finish Metal + Glass
Light Source: Integrated Warm LED
Weight (Kg): 7 Kg
Size : 75 mm × 75 mm × 1800 / 2100mm




*Size, shape, and design can be customized to project requirements.

Delicate red glass leaves emerge as symbols of life, resilience, and renewal,
           gracefully connected through flowing golden chains.
These elements intertwine with the charred bamboo structure, creating a
    striking contrast between fragility and strength, decay and rebirth.
  Encircling the composition, the golden rings represent an unbreakable
   bond with the inevitable cycle of transformation — a poetic balance
            between permanence and impermanence.
 The installation becomes not just a lighting sculpture, but a narrative of
                continuity, hope, and timeless connection.

CHHEEN
                          Desert Whisper

    Flowing like the desert winds across Rajasthan,
 CHHEEN transforms traditional fabric craftsmanship
   into a sculptural suspended form. Inspired by the
    softness of hand-draped textiles seen in Jaipur’s
heritage craft traditions, the layered silhouette creates a
       feeling of movement, lightness, and calm.

Technical

Finish: Natural Jute Fabric + Stainless Steel
Material: Jute Fabric + Metal Frame
Light Source: Integrated Warm LED
Weight (Kg): 15 Kg
Size 1 : 800 mm × 400 mm × 300 mm
Size 2 : 900 mm × 600 mm × 600 mm
Size 3 : 1200 mm × 800 mm × 900 mm


*Size, shape, and design can be customized to project requirements.

The organic flowing form of CHHEEN introduces softness into architectural
spaces, balancing scale with delicacy. The translucent jute fabric gently filters
     illumination, creating a warm atmospheric presence that feels both
               contemporary and deeply rooted in craft.

Designed as a suspended sculptural installation, CHHEEN celebrates texture,
 movement, and material honesty — where fabric becomes form, and form
                    becomes atmosphere.

Maru Bel
                 The Desert Vine of Rajasthan


 Inspired by the naturally growing Maru Bel vine found
across Rajasthan’s arid landscape, this sculptural lighting
piece transforms the flowing rhythm of desert creepers
            into contemporary llumination.

Technical

Material: Metal + Glass
Light Source: Integrated Warm LED
Weight (Kg): 2–3 Kg
Size : 200 mm × 120 mm × 1550 mm




*Size, shape, and design can be customized to project requirements.

The elongated metallic structure reflects the organic movement of climbing
 desert vines, while the glowing handcrafted glass spheres are inspired by the
   vibrant berries blooming across the delicate stems of the Maru Bel plant.
  Crafted with refined metallic detailing and illuminated glass forms, MARU
BELbalances warmth, movement, and sculptural elegance — creating a poetic
               dialogue between nature, material, and light.

CHIDKOLI
                 THE MARWARI BIRDS

Crafted in backlit alabaster stone, the light is inspired by
the quiet presence of birds resting in a moonlit garden,
Chidkoli transforms outdoor lighting into an emotional
   landscape experience. More than a luminaire, it
behaves like a glowing living form — softly illuminating
  pathways, gardens, and architectural greens with a
            warm poetic glow.

 the landscape; at night, it awakens into a gentle beacon of warmth, casting a
             diffused amber glow across grass, stone, and foliage.

bases, creating a refined contrast between ethereal
     illumination and grounded natural stone.

Light Source: Integrated Warm LED

*Size, shape, and design can be customized to project requirements.

Available in curated semi-precious stones like – quartz, amethyst, onyx,
 alabaster, each sculpture creates its own visual personality while harmonizing

Dhwani stambh

       Light, held within. Revealed with intention.
 The illumination is warm, intimate, and atmospheric.
             It does not flood the space. It lingers.
 The perforated mesh transforms light into a pattern—
       subtle, ever-changing, and deeply human.
This is not just light; it’s a whole experience with an app-
controlled sound system and a calming aroma diffuser.

Kankad
                        Echoes of Stone

   Across the landscapes of Rajasthan, scattered desert
stones quietly shape the character of the land — softened
 by time, sun, and shifting winds. KANKAD captures this
raw simplicity through a composition of glowing alabaster
          forms and casted brass elements.
 The illuminated stone pieces resemble smooth pebbles
resting across the desert terrain, creating a sculptural form
        that feels organic, balanced, and timeless.

Technical

Finish: Natural Alabaster & Metallic Finish
Material: Alabaster Stone & Metal
Light Source: Integrated Warm LED
Weight (Kg): 8–12 Kg
Size : 111 mm × 980 mm × 127 mm




*Size, shape, and design can be customized to project requirements.

The warm brass accents introduce depth and richness, reflecting
  the handcrafted detailing and material warmth often associated
                 with Jaipur’s artisanal culture.

    Each element is intentionally imperfect yet harmonious —
     celebrating natural texture, softness, and quiet elegance.

KANKAD brings together earth, material, and glow in a way that feels
   intimate, contemporary, and deeply connected to Rajasthan’s
                           landscape.

Meghchhatra
                   The Canopy of Monsoon



 Inspired by the rare arrival of monsoon across Rajasthan,
this sculptural lighting piece captures the poetic moment
     when rain transforms the desert landscape.

Technical

Finish: Textured Brass
Material: Brass & Textured Glass Stone
Light Source: Integrated Warm LED
Weight (Kg): 1.2 Kg (per pcs)
Size : 184 mm × 184 mm × 305 mm




*Size, shape, and design can be customized to project requirements.

The layered glass forms resemble protective canopies emerging over
 the dunes, while the flowing arrangement recreates the rhythm of
                     drifting clouds and falling rain.
  Soft illumination radiates through every element, celebrating the
 contrast between Rajasthan's arid beauty and its fleeting season of
                            renewal.
MEGHCHHATRA becomes a suspended landscape where light, water,
      and heritage come together in a contemporary form.

Inspired by the sculptural artistry of Danny Lane.
